_comment: config/relations.json for the Hakken paper's biomedical schema: merges from Table E3, polarity rules from Table E2. Copy to hakken/config/relations.json.

definitions.INCREASES_EXPRESSION_OF: subject raises mRNA or protein expression of object
definitions.DECREASES_EXPRESSION_OF: subject lowers mRNA or protein expression of object
definitions.AFFECTS_EXPRESSION_OF: subject changes expression of object (direction unknown or conflicting)
definitions.INHIBITS: subject reduces the activity or function of object
definitions.TREATS: subject (drug/intervention) is used to treat object (disease)
definitions.PREVENTS: subject reduces incidence or onset of object
definitions.IS_A_BIOMARKER_FOR: subject's level indicates presence or state of object
definitions.IS_A_TARGET_FOR: subject is a therapeutic target for object
